name: login-page
title: Login page
description: Page-level login block: password and verification-code tabs, inline TOTP challenge and third-party provider entries. Transport, navigation and copy come from the host through props.
postInstall: Render <LoginPage labels={...} port={...} /> inside your auth shell. The host supplies translated labels, a signIn/sendVerificationCode port, optional notices and oauthProviders, and navigates from onSignedIn. Requires the shadcn ui primitives button, card, input, label and tabs.
